seo.title: Class Timetable | FIT X Studio, Manunda Cairns
seo.description: This week's strength, mat Pilates, mums and bubs, Saturday HIIT and open gym sessions at FIT X Studio, Manunda. Book online, and buy class packs and single sessions.

hero.headline: Find your class.
hero.sub: Live times from our booking system. Pick a class, tap Book and sign in with Mindbody. Cancel free up to 12 hours before.
hero.passesLink: Need a pass? Packs and single sessions

schedule.headline: This week
schedule.note: Booking a class needs a pass or membership.

passes.headline: Need a pass?
passes.sub: Buy a single session or a class pack right here, then book your class on the timetable above. Payment goes through Mindbody, our booking system.
passes.membershipsHeadline: Training every week? Become a member.
passes.membershipsNote: Prices are per week, GST included, with a 12-week or 6-month minimum.
passes.trialNote: New to FIT X? Start with 2 weeks unlimited for $89. It counts towards your minimum term.
passes.legal: Prices may change. The fee schedule you're given when you join applies.

items.title: What to bring
items.body: Water bottle, towel and enclosed training shoes. Grip socks for mat Pilates (bring yours or buy from us).

items.title: Cancelling
items.body: Free up to 12 hours before class. If you miss three booked classes in 30 days without cancelling in time, a $10 fee applies from the third.

items.title: Getting here
items.body: Shed 6, 261–273 McCormack Street, Manunda. Designated customer parking on site, plus on-street parking.
